description: Translate the underground chase and Melody capture tutorial.

english:
Meow! Time to
skedaddle,
meow!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Well, you're so
cute, I'll make
a special
exception! I'll
take you on an
underground
expedition with
my special
technique!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Underground
expedition!
Here we go!♪
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Whoa, what the
heck just
happened?!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
That was the
Digging skill!
To chase them,
we need a
Digimon with
Digging. Use
Melody Capture
to obtain one,
materialize it
in the DigiLab,
add it to your
party, and go
together.
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Melody Capture?
Materialize it
in the DigiLab?
I know I've
heard that
somewhere...
What does it
mean again?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
If you defeat
an uninjured
Digimon in one
hit, or finish
it with a
Melody-effect
attack, the
defeated
Digimon becomes
a Melody! If
you use a move
that hits its
weakness, it's
more likely to
become a
Melody. If you
use an
attribute it's
strong against,
it's less
likely. You can
turn a Melody
you obtain into
a Digimon in
the DigiLab!
Um... what
else...? I
can't... I'm
tired... Ask
Guilmon or
Veemon at the
Sky Fortress
for the
details...
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Either way, we
need more
allies. Which
Digimon know
the Digging
skill?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Guilmon at
Knuckle Coast
and Dorulumon
in the
mountains near
the Sky
Fortress can
dig. The
Tyrannomon
around here
should be able
to, too.
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Then let's head
back for now,
Shoutmon.
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english: All right...
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Oh! There's a
Digimon in our
party with the
Digging skill!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Great! Let's
chase them!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
We finally
escaped Ring
Wandering by
digging... Why
is there still
nothing but
darkness
ahead?!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Aaah... so
dark... I'm
dizzy from all
this
darkness...
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
M-my gosh! It
appeared! A
ghost?! A
spirit?! A
monster?!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
D-Digimon...
meow?!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Yeah! It's a
terrifying
monster that
will capture
and restrain
us! The only
thing to do is
escape! You
understand?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Meow! Yes,
meow?!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
All right!
Let's run!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Darn it! We
were so close
to catching it!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Aah! I hate
this dark
place! Taiki,
Shoutmon...
hurry up and
chase them so
we can get out!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
What a coward,
Spadamon!
Anyway, let's
chase them!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Even past the
darkness,
there's more
darkness...
It's just like
my life!
Yee-haw!♪
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
What's wrong?
You're
trembling. Are
you scared of
the dark?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
N-no... I'm
n-not scared!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english: A-a-aah...
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Hey! Team
Cute's rule is:
when you're in
trouble, laugh!
Even when
things get
tough or you're
in a pinch,
laugh it off!
You understand?
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
...... I...
Meow! I'll
laugh, meow!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Ah... You're so
very cute!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Team Cute, full
speed ahead!
Let's charge!♪
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Meow! Charge
forward, meow!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Ugh... We were
so close to
catching it...
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Hee-hee! Good
for you,
squishy! You're
alive in a
beautiful
flower garden!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.

english:
Hey,
Chibickmon! Are
you okay?!
blocks.review_note: Mission dialogue and the Melody capture tutorial translated directly from Japanese. Character, feature, and skill terms follow the project style.
